pretreatments.description: Ultrasonic assisted potassium hydroxide pretreatment (KOH_Upt) involving the application of 2%, 4%, and 6% (w/w) concentrations of potassium hydroxide (KOH) solutions to wheat straw (WS) samples in triplicate using an ultrasonic bath (KH5200DE, Nanjing Xiao Equipment Company, China) at 20 kHz. Pretreatment was carried out in ambient temperature (22 ± 1) °C for an optimum time of 36 hours, where pH was monitored every 4 hours and ceased when a steady value was reached to prevent hydrothermal degradation or microbial damage. This pretreatment process disrupted the lignocellulosic structure by combining ultrasonic cavitation and alkali dissolution, enhancing hydrolysis rates of hemicellulose and ester bonds between lignin and cellulose, resulting in increased volatile fatty acids (VFA) production and improved biogasification and anaerobic digestion performance compared to untreated or single pretreatment samples.
